raw_text: A fictional war gaming scenario posted on an Indian defence forum was stripped of its context and shared widely on social media as a genuine Chinese military plan to invade India's Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The original post, part of a months-long collaborative fiction exercise, was clearly labelled as fiction. However, screenshots omitting the disclaimers went viral on Telegram and X, briefly alarming OSINT communities. The incident highlights the challenge of context-stripping in information operations and the speed at which fictional content can be weaponised.
clean_text: The Diplomat reports fictional war game scenario from Indian defence forum was context-stripped and shared as genuine Chinese invasion plan. Original clearly labelled fiction. Viral screenshots omitted disclaimers. Highlights context-stripping challenge in information operations.
